arxiv-2111-10142.creator: Nico Blokker, André Blessing, Erenay Dayanik, Jonas Kuhn, Sebastian Padó, Gabriella Lapesa
arxiv-2111-10142.description: Abstract Newspaper reports provide a rich source of information on the unfolding of public debate on specific policy fields that can serve as basis for inquiry in political science. Such debates are often triggered by critical events, which attract public attention and incite the reactions of political actors: crisis sparks the debate.

arxiv-2111-13550.title: Using Fictitious Class Representations to Boost Discriminative Zero-Shot Learners
arxiv-2111-13550.creator: Mohammed Dabbah, Ran El-Yaniv
arxiv-2111-13550.description: Abstract Focusing on discriminative zero-shot learning, in this work we introduce a novel mechanism that dynamically augments during training the set of seen classes to produce additional fictitious classes. These fictitious classes diminish the model’s tendency to fixate during training on attribute correlations that appear in the training set but will not appear in newly exposed classes.

arxiv-2503-06229.title: A Frank System for Co-Evolutionary Hybrid Decision-Making
arxiv-2503-06229.creator: Federico Mazzoni ✉, Riccardo Guidotti, Alessio Malizia
arxiv-2503-06229.description: Abstract We introduce Frank , a human-in-the-loop system for co-evolutionary hybrid decision-making aiding the user to label records from an un-labeled dataset. Frank employs incremental learning to “evolve” in parallel with the user’s decisions, by training an interpretable machine learning model on the records labeled by the user.

arxiv-2602-17148.title: Integrable cellular automata on finite fields of order 2 n 2^{n}
arxiv-2602-17148.creator: Aoi Araoka, Tetsuji Tokihiro
arxiv-2602-17148.description: Abstract This paper explores cellular automata (CA) constructed from Yang–Baxter maps over finite fields 𝔽 2 n \mathbb{F}_{2^{n}} . We define R R -matrices using a map f f on 𝔽 2 n \mathbb{F}_{2^{n}} and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for f f to satisfy the Yang–Baxter equation. We show that these conditions become remarkably streamlined in characteristic two.

pmc-10538081.title: Effectiveness of the Booster Dose in Protecting against COVID-19, Colombia 2022
pmc-10538081.creator: Jubby Marcela Gálvez, Ángela María Pinzón-Rondón, Henry Mauricio Chaparro-Solano, Hanna Valentina Tovar-Romero, Juliana Ramírez-Prieto, Sergio Andrés Ortigoza-Espitia, Ángela María Ruiz-Sternberg
pmc-10538081.description: Vaccination has proven to be one of the most effective strategies against the COVID-19 pandemic. Several studies have evaluated and confirmed its effectiveness in different populations, particularly in reducing severe outcomes such as hospitalization and death. Some studies have investigated the effectiveness of vaccination against the infection, identifying the need for booster doses.

pmc-10738106.title: USING INTENSIVE REPEATED MEASUREMENT TO EXAMINE THE AFFECTIVE CONSEQUENCES OF NEGATIVE RELATIONSHIP EXPERIENCES
pmc-10738106.creator: Dakota Witzel, Kelly Cichy
pmc-10738106.description: Across midlife and older adulthood, daily relational contexts provide a lens through which daily experiences shape health and well-being. How daily relational contexts inform health and well-being is complex, with buffering and exacerbating effects of the relationship context on well-being reported in past work. One mechanism through which daily relational experiences influence health and well-being is through changes in emotions.

pmc-11394004.title: New Insights into the Exosome-Induced Migration of Uveal Melanoma Cells and the Pre-Metastatic Niche Formation in the Liver
pmc-11394004.creator: Raquel Ramos, Antònia Vinyals, Rafael Campos-Martin, Eduard Cabré, Joan Josep Bech, Javier Vaquero, Ester Gonzalez-Sanchez, Esther Bertran, Josep Ramon Ferreres, Daniel Lorenzo, Carolina G. De La Torre, Isabel Fabregat, Jose Maria Caminal, Àngels Fabra
pmc-11394004.description: Simple SummaryUveal melanoma (UM) is the most common primary intraocular tumor in adults, with a high incidence of liver metastasis causing poor survival. However, the mechanisms underlying this liver tropism remain poorly understood. Our study focused on the roles of UM exosomes along the metastatic process.

pmc-11595751.title: Fresh Hemorrhages in Intestinal Resection Margins Are Associated with Unfavorable Clinical Outcomes in Preterm Infants with Necrotizing Enterocolitis with Surgical Intervention
pmc-11595751.creator: Ole Schickedanz, Florian Friedmacher, Steffen Gretser, Yannick Braun, Peter Johanes Wild, Udo Rolle, Elise Gradhand, Eleni Stamellou, Stefanos Roumeliotis
pmc-11595751.description: Background: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a common disease in premature infants. If conservative treatment does not respond, surgical removal of the necrotic section of bowel is common practice. This study investigates whether there is a correlation between the histopathological findings and the postoperative clinical course of the children who have undergone surgery.

pmc-12745984.title: Accurate quantitation of antibiotic penetration through staphylococcal biofilms
pmc-12745984.creator: Lou Bin, David McGiffin, Thuy Nguyen, Lv Wang, Yao Sun, Lumei Ye, Meiling Han, Chengju Sheng, Tzong-Hsien Lee, Marie-Isabel Aguilar, Anton Y Peleg, Yue Qu
pmc-12745984.description: ObjectivesLimited antimicrobial penetration is an important mechanism underlying antimicrobial resistance of biofilms and has often been incorrectly quantitated. We adopted a rationalized antibiotic agar-diffusion model to accurately interpret experimental results of a widely-accepted biofilm penetration assay, and to determine drug-related physiochemical properties impacting antimicrobial biofilm penetration.MethodsStaphylococcal reference strains and eight conventional antibiotics were selected for this study.

pmc-13081715.title: Mono- and co-infections of primary porcine respiratory cells with Bordetella bronchiseptica and Streptococcus suis are not affected by the dermonecrotic toxin
pmc-13081715.creator: Désirée Schaaf, Muriel Dresen, Yenehiwot Berhanu Weldearegay, Jeannine Biermann, Susan L. Brockmeier, Wolfgang Baumgärtner, Michael Jarek, Peter Valentin-Weigand
pmc-13081715.description: Bordetella bronchiseptica is a gram-negative bacterium contributing to respiratory diseases in many different animal species. In the swine population, it occurs frequently and plays a role in the Porcine Respiratory Disease Complex as well as in the pathogenesis of atrophic rhinitis.

pmc-13183703.title: Acromelic dysplasias: similarities and differences in clinical and molecular findings in 12 Turkish patients
pmc-13183703.creator: N. Güneş, S. Türk, H. Onur, K. Gür, C. Yüksel Elgin, E. Çifçi Sunamak, D. Uludağ Alkaya, A. Güler Eroğlu, B. Tüysüz
pmc-13183703.description: The purpose of this study is to compare the natural history of clinical and radiologic features in patients with acromelic dysplasias. Twelve patients from nine families with genetically confirmed dysplasia types with acromelia were included in the study, and eight of them were followed-up for a median of 8.1 years.
